agreed_facts.text: A building belonging to Saudi oil company Aramco was struck in an attack attributed to Yemen's Houthis.
The Saudi Energy Ministry said the strike caused a limited fire in an administrative building belonging to Aramco.
The Houthis said they had targeted Aramco facilities and vowed further attacks.
The target is described as Aramco's headquarters or executive offices.
The Houthis are described as Iran-backed.

headline_quotes.quote: War Spikes Between Houthis and Saudi Arabia
Limited Fire In Building At Aramco Compound
Iran-Backed Houthis Struck Saudi Oil Giant Aramco's Executive Offices

emphasis.text: Leads with an escalating war between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia, noting a prior Houthi warning and the Saudi-led coalition's targeting of Houthi capabilities.
Foregrounds the Saudi ministry's account of a limited fire.
Describes the Houthis as Iran-backed and the strike as a demonstration of their ability to hit high-profile targets.

headline_quotes.quote: Houthis say targeted Saudi oil giant Aramco, vow more attacks

emphasis.text: Leads with the Houthis' own claim of targeting Aramco and their threat of further attacks or escalation.

omissions.text: Left coverage does not mention the Houthis vowing further attacks after the strike.
Centre coverage does not describe the Houthis as Iran-backed.
Centre coverage does not mention the Saudi ministry's report of a limited fire.

emphasis.text: Reports the Houthis' stated motive of retaliating for Saudi backing of Yemeni government forces in a war that restarted last month.
